details:
Dear VRChat Support Team,

I am writing to report a persistent issue I am experiencing when attempting to launch and play VRChat. The game consistently fails to properly connect to online services, resulting in a recurring "Offline Test Mode" message and preventing me from joining any online worlds.

I have analyzed my log file and identified the following critical errors:

OpenVR/SteamVR Initialization Failures:

Error - [OpenVR] Could not initialize OpenVR. Error code: Init_HmdNotFoundPresenceFailed

Warning - [SteamVR] Initialization failed. Please verify that you have SteamVR installed, your hmd is functioning, and OpenVR Loader is checked in the XR Plugin Management section of Project Settings.

(Note: While I have a VR-capable system, I was attempting to launch in desktop mode when this occurred. The game eventually defaults to desktop, but these errors appear at launch.)

Repeated EOSManager Backend Errors:

Warning - [EOSManager] [Warning][LogEOS] Error response received from backend. Response is not JSON. ServiceName=[SDKConfig], OperationName=[GetPlatformConfigRoute], Url=[<Redacted>], HttpStatus=[403], CorrId=[]

Warning - [EOSManager] [Warning][LogEOS] SDK Config Platform Update Request Failed, Result Code: EOS_UnrecognizedResponse, Retrying after...

Error - [EOSManager] EOS Login Failed. ResultCode: 12

These warnings and errors indicate a failure to communicate with or authenticate against the Epic Online Services (EOS) backend, specifically receiving "403 Forbidden" and "UnrecognizedResponse" for SDK configuration updates, leading to login failures. ResultCode 12 suggests a connection timeout or general failure to connect.

Photon Authentication Failure:

Error - OperationResponse 230: ReturnCode: 32736 (No auth request during expected wait time). Parameters: {} Server: NameServer Address: wss://ns.photonengine.io:443

This shows a failure to authenticate with the Photon NameServer, likely a direct consequence of the EOS login failures.

Forced "Offline Test Mode":

Warning - [Behaviour] Failed to join instance 'wrld_288f1564-13b7-45fd-bd99-813e918404db:46290~friends(usr_3cc4adc5-986b-4984-8c11-a25e6e38c8d4)~region(jp)' due to 'オフラインテストモードでいる間は、オンラインのワールドに移動することはできません。VRChat を通常通り起動する場合は、"launch.exe"を使用して起動してください。通常通りに起動しなかった場合、ショートカットを更新する必要があるかもしれません。'

This is the final user-facing error, stating that I cannot join online worlds while in offline test mode.

Steps I have already taken to troubleshoot:

Verified integrity of game files via Steam.

Cleared VRChat cache (C:\Users\toshi\AppData\LocalLow\VRChat\VRChat\Cache).

Ensured no VPN/Proxy is active.

Checked firewall/antivirus (temporarily disabled for testing - issue persists).

Attempted launching VRChat directly from Steam and via VRChat.exe.

My internet connection is stable, and other online games function normally.

System Information:

VRChat Build: 2025.2.2p1-1649-71a7b50816-Release

Store: Steam

Platform: standalonewindows

OS: Windows 11 (10.0.26100) 64bit

CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core Processor

GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (8024MB)

System Memory: 32649MB

Selected Network Region: Japan

I kindly request your assistance in resolving this issue. Please let me know if you require any further information or log files.

Thank you for your time and support.

Sincerely,

haze-san
title: [BUG] Repeated EOS Login Failures & Offline Test Mode Loop (ResultCode 12)
